title: ToolRM: Towards Agentic Tool-Use Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Renhao Li、Jianhong Tu、Yang Su、Yantao Liu、Fei Huang、Hamid Alinejad-Rokny、Derek F. Wong、Junyang Lin、Min Yang
paper_type_zh: 工具调用奖励模型与成对偏好轨迹论文
best_for_zh: 需要从工具轨迹构造可验证偏好并训练智能体奖励模型的读者。
one_line: ToolRM builds verifiable pairwise preferences from tool-use trajectories and trains generative and discriminative reward models for agentic optimization.
ToolRM 从工具使用轨迹构造可验证的成对偏好，并训练生成式和判别式奖励模型服务智能体优化。
why: It makes the connection between a data object and a training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: The paper changes how a training record, selection signal, reward, or trajectory is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Tool-using agents can produce a fluent explanation while calling a wrong function, using invalid arguments, or ignoring an available tool result. Terminal success alone is sparse, while generic preference judges may not understand the schema and execution constraints of a tool trajectory.

ToolRM asks how reward modelling can evaluate tool use with feedback tied to executable interactions. It represents the target as a preference between trajectories whose calls and observations can be checked against task-specific rules and reference behaviour.

使用工具的智能体可以给出流畅解释，却调用错误函数、使用无效参数，或忽略可用工具结果。终局成功信号十分稀疏，而通用偏好评判器未必理解工具轨迹的模式和执行约束。

ToolRM 追问奖励建模如何用与可执行交互相关的反馈评估工具使用。它把目标表示为轨迹之间的偏好，其中调用和观察可以依据任务特定规则及参考行为被检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core record is a tool-use context paired with a chosen and rejected trajectory. It retains tool specifications, calls, observations, and the comparison label, so a reward model can learn not merely whether an answer sounds good but whether the action sequence is operationally appropriate.

The official release is named ToolPref-Pairwise-30K. Its hosted configuration currently exposes more rows than the name suggests, so a reuse study should pin the exact split and configuration rather than treating the title as a complete count specification.

核心记录是与获选和拒选轨迹配对的工具使用语境。它保留工具说明、调用、观察和比较标签，因此奖励模型学习的不只是答案是否听起来合理，还包括行动序列是否在操作上恰当。

官方发布名为 ToolPref-Pairwise-30K。其托管配置当前显示的行数多于名称暗示的数量，因此复用研究应固定准确划分和配置，不能把名称当作完整的数量说明。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors collect and normalize trajectories from seven tool-use datasets, segment contexts and responses, validate calls against schemas and task rules, and sample alternative model outputs. Rule-based comparison produces chosen and rejected trajectories with controlled complexity and interaction intensity.

They train both generative and discriminative reward models on these records. The generative model can explain a judgement, while the discriminative model supplies a direct preference score; the paper then studies their use as reward signals for downstream agent training.

作者从七个工具使用数据集收集并规范化轨迹，分割语境和回复，依据模式及任务规则验证调用，并采样替代模型输出。基于规则的比较生成复杂度和交互强度受控的获选与拒选轨迹。

他们在这些记录上训练生成式和判别式奖励模型。生成式模型能够解释判断，判别式模型提供直接偏好分数；论文随后研究把它们作为下游智能体训练奖励信号的用途。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports up to 17.94 percentage points of pairwise reward-judgement accuracy improvement over the stated frontier language-model and reward-model comparisons. It also evaluates the reward models in downstream tool-use optimization, linking preference quality to an agent-training consumer.

This evidence supports the tool-specific construction and the reported task mixture. It does not establish that a rule checker covers all semantically valid tool strategies, or that a trajectory judged preferable in one tool interface transfers to a different API, permission model, or environment.

论文报告，在成对奖励判断准确率上，相对所述前沿语言模型和奖励模型对照最高提升 17.94 个百分点。它还在下游工具使用优化中评测奖励模型，将偏好质量与智能体训练消费者连接起来。

该证据支持工具特定构造和所报告的任务混合。它并不说明规则检查器覆盖所有语义上有效的工具策略，也不说明在一种工具接口中被判断为更好的轨迹能迁移到不同接口、权限模型或环境。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior agent reward datasets can treat a trajectory as ordinary text or use a final task label without exposing whether the intermediate calls are executable. ToolRM makes schema- and rule-checked tool interactions part of the preference construction.

It also compares generative and discriminative reward consumers on the same record type. The novelty is therefore an executable, trajectory-level preference interface for training reward models, rather than only a new policy-optimization algorithm.

先前智能体奖励数据集可能把轨迹当作普通文本，或使用最终任务标签而不暴露中间调用是否可执行。ToolRM 把经过模式和规则检查的工具交互纳入偏好构造。

它还在同一记录类型上比较生成式和判别式奖励消费者。因此，新意在于用于训练奖励模型的、可执行的轨迹级偏好接口，而不只是一个新的策略优化算法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Programmatic validation can reject unconventional but valid strategies and may miss semantic errors after a syntactically valid call. The dataset combines several sources and configurations, so users should inspect licenses, tool availability, and the exact verifier rules for each subset before training.
程序化验证可能拒绝非传统却有效的策略，也可能在调用语法有效后漏掉语义错误。数据集结合多个来源和配置，因此使用者应在训练前检查每个子集的许可、工具可用性和准确验证规则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it when agent traces contain enough tool metadata to replay or validate calls. Keep the checker separate from the reward model, audit false preference pairs, and compare a generic text judge with a schema-aware reward model before using either signal for policy optimization.
当智能体轨迹包含足以回放或验证调用的工具元数据时，可使用该工作。应让检查器与奖励模型保持分离，审计错误偏好对，并在用任一信号进行策略优化前比较通用文本评判器和模式感知奖励模型。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The record’s value comes from retained interaction structure, not its prose alone. Read the trajectory normalisation and rule-checking steps closely: they define what the preference label certifies and which kinds of tool errors remain invisible.
记录的价值来自保留的交互结构，而不只是其中的文字。应仔细阅读轨迹规范化和规则检查步骤：它们定义偏好标签证明什么，以及哪些工具错误仍不可见。
